name: backfold
description: Summarize a local time-series CSV, then inspect the original observations in a selected time range.
long_description: Five local tools summarize a CSV, inspect a time window, smooth a signal, compare channels with PCA, and sift multiple streams. The server reads files at the paths you supply. Includes native executables for Linux x86-64, Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x86-64.

tools.name: backfold_digest_csv
tools.description: Summarize a numeric time-series column and identify time windows to inspect.

tools.name: backfold_drill_csv
tools.description: Return observations and summary statistics for an inclusive time window.

tools.name: backfold_kalman_rts_csv
tools.description: Smooth a signal at selected timestamps using a Kalman filter and RTS smoother.

tools.name: backfold_covariance_pca_csv
tools.description: Compare numeric columns using covariance and principal components.

tools.name: backfold_ebh_sift_csv
tools.description: Sift multiple streams using e-values and a false discovery rate target.
